purpose: Add repeated-route anchors for transparent bubble helmets, wrapped identity masks, anthropomorphic species masks, and dedicated Wookiee head geometry.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Skeleton, Evil Skull Print

records.training_note: The skull identity is printed on a standard head while a separate round bubble helmet supplies transparent enclosure geometry. Keep those channels independent.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Wolf Warrior, Silver Face Mask, Nougat Eye Shadow, Black Eyes / Blue Eyes and Fangs Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Wrap with Wolf Mask with Medium Azure Eyes, Teeth/Fangs pattern

records.training_note: Mask identity is deliberately split across printed face coverage and a separate wolf-mask wrap. Treat the wrap as identity-bearing silhouette geometry, not generic protective headgear.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Lloyd, Black and Yellow Eye Mask, Angry Grin / Dark Red Eyebrows, Green Eyes, Angry Stare print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Wrap with Short Back Knot Smooth, Bright Green Mask pattern

records.training_note: The exposed-eye/facial state is printed on the head while a separate fabric-like ninja wrap supplies external mask silhouette and knot geometry.

records.figure_name: Chewbacca, Dark Brown - Long Lines on Legs on Inside

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Special, Wookiee with Dark Tan Face Fur and Teeth Print (Chewbacca)

records.training_note: Chewbacca's cranial/facial volume is carried by one dedicated Wookiee head element rather than a standard head plus removable mask.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Crug, Crocodile, Silver Lower Jaw, Wide Eyes / Narrow Eyes Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask Crocodile with Silver Lower Jaw Print

records.training_note: Crug repeats the Chima crocodile strategy: expression on a standard cylindrical head, silhouette/jaw identity on a separate crocodile mask.

systemic_findings: Layered printed-mask plus wrap assemblies should be represented separately from both bare printed masks and rigid cowls.
Transparent bubble geometry remains a reusable enclosure route even when the underlying character is nonhuman or stylized.
Dedicated creature heads and removable species masks are distinct physical strategies and should remain separate supervision classes.
